Title: Order Product Snapshot — Async Enqueue and Job Succeeds on New Order
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:TECHFLOW_ADMIN]
- [PRECHECK] Module installed: GET {{BACK_URL}}api/platform/modules → VirtoCommerce.ProductSnapshot present with state Installed/Active (capture version); if the module is absent, BLOCK this case as an environment gap — do not report as a defect
- Platform -> Settings -> Product Snapshot -> General: ProductSnapshot.Enabled = ON (verify via GET {{BACK_URL}}api/platform/settings/modules/VirtoCommerce.ProductSnapshot)
- At least one product with known SKU exists in the catalog (live-discover)
- Hangfire dashboard accessible at {{BACK_URL}}/hangfire
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}connect/token grant_type=password&username={{AGENT1_EMAIL}}&password={{AGENT1_PASSWORD}}&storeId=B2B-store → capture access_token
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — query { me { id } } → capture userId
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — products(storeId:"B2B-store" first:1 filter:"status:enabled") { items { id name } } → capture productId (live-discover: first available in-stock product)
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — addItem(command:{ storeId:"B2B-store" userId:{userId} productId:{productId} quantity:1 currencyCode:"USD" cultureName:"en-US" }) { id } → capture cartId
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — availableShippingMethods(storeId:"B2B-store" userId:{userId}) → capture shipmentMethodCode, shipmentMethodOption, price
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — addOrUpdateCartShipment(command:{ storeId:"B2B-store" userId:{userId} shipment:{ shipmentMethodCode:{shipmentMethodCode} shipmentMethodOption:{shipmentMethodOption} price:{price} deliveryAddress:{ countryCode:"US" postalCode:"10001" line1:"123 Test St" city:"New York" regionCode:"NY" } } }) { id }
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — addOrUpdateCartPayment(command:{ storeId:"B2B-store" userId:{userId} payment:{ paymentGatewayCode:"DefaultManualPaymentMethod" } }) { id }
[GQL] POST {{BACK_URL}}graphql — createOrderFromCart(command:{ cartId:{cartId} }) → capture orderId, orderNumber
[ASSERT] Verify orderNumber is non-null (order created successfully)
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/hangfire/jobs/enqueued — Hangfire Enqueued Jobs
[WAIT] Job named 'SaveOrderProductSnapshotsJob.ExecuteAsync' appears in the Enqueued or Succeeded list (allow up to 30s)
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/hangfire/jobs/succeeded — Hangfire Succeeded Jobs
[WAIT] The same job moves to Succeeded state (allow up to 90s total); expected transitions: Created → Enqueued → Processing → Succeeded (~2–5s processing)
[API] GET {{BACK_URL}}api/product-snapshots/order/{orderId}/product/{productId} → verify HTTP 200 and snapshot DTO is non-null
[ASSERT] Response contains productId matching the ordered product and at least one catalog field (code or name)
Assertions:
[BLADE] Order is visible in Admin Orders list with status 'New' (navigate to Orders module)
[BLADE] 'SaveOrderProductSnapshotsJob.ExecuteAsync' (namespace VirtoCommerce.ProductSnapshot.Data.BackgroundJobs) appears in Hangfire within 30s of order creation
[BLADE] Job transitions: Created → Enqueued → Processing → Succeeded (not Failed or Deleted)
[API] GET {{BACK_URL}}api/product-snapshots/order/{orderId}/product/{productId} returns HTTP 200 with non-null snapshot DTO
